head: claude/mi154-scalp-exit-head-artifact-20260906
title: MI-154: the scalp exit-head artifact is the SECOND missing half, not the first
body:
## What this lane was asked to do, and what is actually true

This lane was opened to **publish a 5m/15m scalp exit-head artifact** so the M20 consumer could score an `ict_scalp` leg. The brief said PR #11140 had *shipped* that consumer, that arming it "would change nothing", and that only the artifact was missing.

**The underlying finding is right — there is no 5m/15m scalp head, and both published heads really are 1h donchian. What is wrong is the ORDER.** Measured at `main` `957fc81d`:

| brief said | measured |
|---|---|
| #11140 "ships" the consumer | **OPEN, unmerged** — `state: open`, `merged: false`, tier 3, `landing: hold` |
| gated by `ICT_SCALP_EXIT_HEAD_MODE` | **0 files** at main |
| `src/runtime/exit_head_apply.py` | **0 files** |

*Positive control:* the same probe over `EXIT_LOOP_DECOUPLE_DISABLED` returns **18 files**, so the zeroes are readings, not a broken probe.

## A scalp artifact published today would have no reader

**POPULATION: all 55 strategies in `config/strategies.yaml`**, each resolved through `pipeline.monitor_unit_for` — the same resolver the order-monitor uses.

- The only call site of `maybe_score_exit_head` is `trend_donchian.py:802`.
- **23 legs** reach it. Every one is **1h / 4h / 1d**. On 5m or 15m: **NONE**.
- All **8** `ict_scalp` legs resolve to unit `ict_scalp`, which has **no exit-head call site at all**.

The repo already held this conclusion: 7 of the 8 `ict_scalp` cells read `blocked:no_lever_consumer_in_unit`, and **5 of the 52 rows** in `exit-refinement-coverage.json` carry the operator's 2026-08-23 `SHIP BLOCKED` verdict whose own precondition — *"Re-grade to shipped/passed_unshipped only AFTER a consumer exists in the ict_scalp unit"* — is still unmet.

## Two things the done-condition assumed that do not exist

- **`decision_state` exists nowhere** on main or on the live VM. It is introduced by #11140. A done-condition written against it cannot be evaluated against deployed code.
- **`/api/diag/shadow_stats` cannot be made to list a scalp head by publishing one.** It delegates to `shadow.py::stats`, which aggregates `shadow_predictions.jsonl` — it enumerates models that have **scored**, not artifacts that exist. An artifact with no call site produces no rows and never appears there.

## Live state, reproduced independently

`/api/diag/shadow_stats` (direct over Caddy, ~17:00Z). **POPULATION: 32 model_ids**; positive control — the probe finds both exit-head ids. Exactly two: `exit-head-donchian-1h-v1` (advisory) and `exit-head-donchian-peak-1h-v1` (shadow), count 52 each, both `tf: 1h`. **Confirms the manager's reading.**

Read off the **trainer** via the push-triggered `trainer-diag-relay` (runs `34047425502`, `34047529006`; `state=ran`, `remote_exit=0`), both artifacts declare `family=donchian tf=1h symbols=[BTC,ETH,SOL]`.

⚠️ **That is a fact #11140 says it lacked.** It leaves donchian opted out of its own family check because *"what value its `family` field actually carries has not been read from the mirror (that dir is not on the diag allowlist)."* It has now been read — both carry the literal token `donchian` — which removes the stated reason for the opt-out.

Recorded rather than assumed: both exit-heads carry `last_seen 10:00:01Z` while the regime heads read `16:56:44Z` — ~7h with no scored bar. Consistent with no open donchian 1h position, **not verified** as such.

## The `family` gap — verified, and sharper than briefed

`maybe_score_exit_head` gates on `tf` (line 350) and `symbols` (353) and **never reads `family`**. The decisive evidence is the **sibling**: `entry_head_pwin.maybe_score_entry_pwin` gates on `family` at **line 165**, immediately before the identical `tf` (167) / `symbols` (169) pair, over an artifact from a near-identical exporter — both stamp `"family": fam_dir.name` (`export_exit_head.py:116`, `export_entry_head.py:67`). A `family` reader exists three lines from the same pair, so this is a **dropped check, not a scoping decision**. The exit guard's own docstring even names the hazard it does not check.

⚠️ **But the hazard is LATENT, not live, and the brief overstated it.** It said a scalp artifact "would today be accepted by a donchian-family consumer". It would not — no donchian-monitor leg is on 5m/15m, so the `tf` guard excludes it first. It stops being latent if a scalp head ships at 1h/4h/1d, or a donchian-monitor leg moves to 5m/15m. `exit-head-donchian-1h-v1` is `stage=advisory`, so the collision case is a real-money path.

**FILED, not re-fixed** — `BL-20260906-EXIT-HEAD-GUARD-DROPS-THE-FAMILY-CHECK-ITS-SIBLING-ENTRY-HEAD-GUARD-MAKES`, via `scripts/ops/backlog_append.py` (`similar_ok=True`; I read the 8 lexical near-duplicates first and all were unrelated topics, so this is a new row, not a recurrence). #11140 already implements caller-opt-in family gating **on the same function**; a second implementation would be `RC-BUILT-A-MECHANISM-THAT-ALREADY-EXISTED` plus a guaranteed merge conflict. The row exists so the gap stays tracked if #11140 is closed unmerged.

## The next bug in the chain, found before anyone hit it

Even once #11140 lands, an artifact exported the obvious way **would be refused**. `export_exit_head.py` stamps `family = fam_dir.name`, and the surviving scalp rounds are laid out **per leg** (`ict_scalp_sol_5m/`, `ict_scalp_xrp_5m/`, `ict_scalp_avax_5m/`), while `_ACCEPTED_FAMILIES["ict_scalp"] == {"ict_scalp", "scalp"}`. Fixed in the **companion PR** (`--family` flag) — split out because `pr-landing-guard`'s `TIER1_SURFACE` does not list `scripts/ml/**`.

## This lane is NOT blocked on data

The E0 scalp datasets survive on the trainer — **100% harness rows, `bar_t` coverage 1.0**, 2021 to 2026-06: `scalp_5m_20260814T151003Z` (avax 27,513 / sol 22,120 / xrp 21,258) and `scalp_15m_20260814T135244Z` (sol 10,079 / xrp 9,960 / eth 8,644). No `dataset_gc.jsonl` exists; nothing has pruned them.

⚠️ The **canonically-laid-out path is the unusable one**: `datasets-out/exit_head/1h/ict_scalp_5m/rows.jsonl` — where the exporter's own usage example points a reader — holds 164 rows of which **zero** are `source == "harness"`, so the export exits 1 there.

## What I deliberately did NOT do

**No artifact was published, and nothing was armed.** Publishing a `family=ict_scalp` head into a directory read by a family-blind guard, on behalf of an advisory-stage donchian head, before either the consumer or the family gate exists, is the one ordering that **creates** a latent real-money hazard while producing nothing observable. It is also the shape the operator's own 2026-08-23 verdict rejects one layer down: *"a declared capability with no consumer."*

**Correct order: consumer → family gate → artifact.** This lane is step 3; steps 1 and 2 are recorded as typed `blocked_on` edges on the work object.

If you want the artifact **pre-staged** ahead of the consumer, that is a legitimate call and cheap — the data is present, the companion PR gives the exporter the right family token, and it is one command. It should be recorded as a decision rather than left looking like progress on the done-condition.

## Ships

- `docs/research/MI-154-scalp-exit-head-ordering-2026-09-06.md` — the evidence, with populations on every count.
- `docs/claude/work/objects/WO-20260906-NO-5M-OR-15M-SCALP-EXIT-HEAD.yaml` — created (it did not exist); `lifecycle: waiting`, two **ASSESSED** `blocked_on` edges, not the migrated `NOT_ASSESSED` empty list.
- `docs/claude/OPEN-ITEMS.json` — one `loud` monitoring row with a three-part `clears_when` that refuses the easy clears. Spliced **textually** to preserve the file's non-standard 1-space serialisation; diff is **+14/-0**.
- `docs/claude/health-review-backlog.json` — the family row.

## Landing

`.github/pr-landing/mi154-scalp-exit-head-artifact-20260906.json` → **tier 1 / `self`**; `pr-landing: OK — state=declared_self_land`. Every path is inside `TIER1_SURFACE` (`docs/**`, `.github/**`). `open-items-guard` OK (58 items), `stated-population-guard` OK, `collapsed-state-guard` clean, `wip-ceiling` OK. Not a draft; automerge armed.

Touches no `src/`, no `config/`, no order path, and **no cell `status`** in `docs/research/exit-refinement-coverage.json` (Tier-3).
